mapper.select: SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.staff_id, u.patient_id, u.username, u.password, u.status, u.principal_type, coalesce(s.is_active, false) AS staff_active FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN public.staff s ON s.id = u.staff_id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT ur.id AS assignment_id, r.role_code, ur.department_id, ur.room_id, ur.valid_from, ur.valid_to, p.permission_code FROM public.user_roles ur JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_active = true AND ur.valid_from <= #{now} AND (ur.valid_to IS NULL OR #{now} < ur.valid_to) ORDER BY ur.id, p.permission_code
mapper.update: UPDATE public.users SET last_login_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((principal_type = 'STAFF' AND patient_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.staff s WHERE s.id = users.staff_id AND s.is_active = true)) OR (principal_type = 'PATIENT' AND patient_id IS NOT NULL AND staff_id IS NULL))
